text: Getting ready for the puja
For the puja at the jammi (shami) tree, keep turmeric, kumkuma, sandal paste, akshatalu, flowers, fruit, a coconut, incense sticks and camphor ready.
Place the puja items in a plate and go to the jammi tree.
Prayer to Ganapati
Remember Ganapati and pray that the puja is completed without obstacles.
Sankalpam
Take a few akshatalu and a little water in your right hand.
Resolve that you are performing jammi puja on Vijayadashami, wishing for your family's wellbeing, success in what you undertake and the removal of obstacles.
When the sankalpam is done, release the akshatalu and water into a plate.
Sandal paste, kumkuma and flowers
See the jammi tree as a divine form and bow to it.
Apply a little sandal paste, turmeric and kumkuma at the foot of the tree, and offer flowers and akshatalu.
Prayer to the jammi tree
With folded hands, remembering the jammi tree, recite this shloka.
Pray that the good work you undertake goes on without obstacles and that your family is blessed.
Incense and lamp
Show incense and the lamp before the jammi tree.
Naivedyam
Place fruit, a coconut or the naivedyam you have prepared in a plate.
Seeing the jammi tree as a divine form, offer the naivedyam.
Neerajanam — harathi
Offer harathi to the jammi tree with camphor or the harathi lamp.
When the harathi is done, bow.
Do not take the flame close to the leaves or dry branches.
Pradakshina and jammi leaves
Go around the jammi tree as your family's custom goes, and bow.
Take a few jammi leaves without harming the tree.
As your family's custom goes, treat the leaves as gold, give them to your elders and take their blessings.
Share the jammi leaves with your family and wish one another a happy Vijayadashami.
